scripts.cap:android: cap add android && cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: cap add ios && cap open ios
scripts.cap:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:build && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path public/downloads,dist/downloads; Copy-Item android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk Sahasraartha-SFO.apk -Force; Copy-Item android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk public/downloads/Sahasraartha-SFO.bin -Force; Copy-Item android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk dist/downloads/Sahasraartha-SFO.bin -Force" && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:full: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build:apk && firebase deploy --only hosting
